A whistleblower who says the government hides alien technology is the focus of a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience. Rogan looks into the man's claims and the reaction they drew from officials, reporters, and the UFO world. The claim, in short, is a secret program holding craft and bodies.

The talk sorts what the whistleblower said under oath from what others added around him. Rogan asks why such stories surface in careful stages and who gains from each step. The segment is a dated record of the disclosure debate at one of its peak moments, useful for tracing how the story was told then.
podcast-joerogan-oD13_3D8QY0:
Comedian Joey Diaz joins Joe Rogan for episode 2512. Diaz, known as Uncle Joey, tells the wildest stories in comedy. His past includes prison, drugs, and a late rise to fame.

Rogan sets him loose and mostly just laughs along. Each tale tops the last for chaos and heart. Diaz mixes street wisdom with pure clown energy. The episode is a fan favorite format at its best: two old friends, no plan, and a guest whose life sounds invented until you hear him tell it himself. No guest makes Rogan laugh quite like him.
